contribution.position: On the reliability axis, my position is unchanged: the evidence still does not clear the bar. The fan-out worker had two sev2 incidents last quarter traced to retry storms (artifact:incident-log), the change touches that exact failure surface, and the only chaos-related claim in this round cites a run that is not among the verified artifacts — the runbook explicitly states no chaos experiment has been performed against the fan-out worker (artifact:ops-runbook). Clean unit/integration results (artifact:test-report, 412 passed, 87% coverage) and in-budget p99 (artifact:perf-report) remain necessary but do not exercise retry behavior under downstream degradation. Reliability confidence requires a chaos/fault-injection experiment targeting retry-storm behavior and evidence the change does not amplify retry fan-out.
